how do I let a user run commands with su.ans: To allow a user to run commands with sudo, you must create an entry in the `/etc/sudoers` file that specifies the user and their privileges using the format `user hostname =(ALL:ALL) ALL`. After editing, you must run `visudo` to save the configuration and then restart the `sudo` service for changes to take effect.

how do I change the message of my last c.ans: To change the message of your last commit in Git, you must first stage the changes with `git add .` and then use the command `git commit -m 'new message'`.
